chunks: Muḥammad ibn Ḥumrān narrated from his father, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever travels or marries while the moon is in Scorpio will not see goodness."

key_terms.الْعَقْرَبِ: Scorpio, the astrological sign mentioned in the report
key_terms.سَافَرَ: set out on a journey or traveled

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about traveling or marrying when the moon is in Scorpio?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a discouragement regarding travel or marriage at a particular time, namely when the moon is in Scorpio. Its significance in the chapter is its indication of disliked times connected to beginning important undertakings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2401 - It is narrated by Muhammad ibn Humran from his father, from Abu Abdullah (as):
"Whoever travels or marries while the moon is in Scorpio will not see goodness."
